summary: Structured Obligations Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K, Item 8.01, disclosing a periodic interest distribution by Select Notes Trust LT 2003-5 on the September 15, 2026 distribution date. The trustee, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, reported $219,375.00 of interest received for the interest period from August 15, 2026 through September 15, 2026, allocated pro rata to Certificateholders for Form 1099 reporting. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are cited. This is a routine pass-through reporting notice, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
